title: Chebyshev's inequality for the sample mean of pairwise-uncorrelated random variables
statement: For a family X of pairwise-uncorrelated random variables (indexed by i < n over the finite distribution (p,n)) with common threshold eps > 0: eps^2 * P(|sampleMean(X,n) - E[sampleMean(X,n)]| >= eps) <= (1/n)^2 * sumRange(i => variance(X_i, p, n), n) -- the variance-of-a-sum-of-uncorrelated-terms bound behind the weak law of large numbers.
